Wayanad District Collector V. Chelsasini has declared a holiday for the Kallinkara Government Lower Primary School on Monday (October 26) as it is functioning as a relief camp.
The camp was opened at the school after floodwaters entered Vellachaal Unnathi in Cheeral village following heavy downpours.
A total of 28 people belonging to 10 families were shifted to the camp.
